title: Balochistan Agricultural Income Tax Amendment Ordinance 1997

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Agricultural Income Tax Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 1997
BALOCHISTAN
AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
ORDINANCE VI OF 1997
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Agricultural Income Tax
Act, 1996
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
11th June, 1997]
No.Legis. I-94/Law/93, dated
11-6-1997.------The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan
on 7th June, 1997 is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan
Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have take effect from 10th day of March, 1997.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Agricultural Income Tax Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Substitution of section 3 of Act II of 1996

ORDINANCE VI OF 1997
BALOCHISTAN
AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
ORDINANCE VI OF 1997
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Agricultural Income Tax
Act, 1996
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
11th June, 1997]
No.Legis. I-94/Law/93, dated
11-6-1997.------The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan
on 7th June, 1997 is hereby published for general information:--
3. Substitution of section 3
of Act II of 1996.----In the said Act, for section 3, the following shall
be substituted, namely:--
"3. Levy of tax.--(1)
No tax shall be charged on sailaba/khushaba lands.
(2) Cereals under tube well/open
surface well/well irrigation shall exempted from the tax.
(3) Half rate shall be chargeable
on Dobari crop.
(4) The tax shall be chargeable
on the matured area of cultivated separately for Rabi and Kharif.
(5) The Government may vary the
rates of tax per acre from time to time.
(6) Owners owning 32 acres or
less canal/karez/stream irrigated la shall be exempted from the payment of tax
in respect of wheat, rice and gram.
(7) The tax shall be paid by the
owner of the land in respect of which it is assessed and levied."
